question: Do independently selected terrestrial high-temperature vitrification or impact-melt sites show any reproducible physical or geometric relation to the frozen EDEM/LOVE/Orion coordinate hypotheses beyond ordinary impact, lightning, volcanic or anthropogenic causes?

hypothesis_partition.H0: Known vitrification sites are explained by established local mechanisms; any celestial pattern with EDEM, LOVE or Orion is chance/look-elsewhere unless it survives frozen controls.
hypothesis_partition.H1_project_overlay: A subset of independently selected vitrification sites could encode a repeatable directional or chronological relation to a frozen celestial source model.
hypothesis_partition.H2_giza_failed_attempt_overlay: Giza may be treated only as a failed-attempt/project metaphor unless independent material evidence of vitrification is found; absence of melt cannot itself prove a failed ancient technology.
hypothesis_partition.H3_osiris_return_overlay: A vitrification site may be labelled an Osiris return/burial candidate only as a symbolic project hypothesis until chronology, archaeology and physical causation independently converge.

independent_site_set_v1.name: Libyan Desert Glass field
independent_site_set_v1.why_included: closest high-silica desert analogue to the proposed Giza vitrification idea

independent_site_set_v1.name: Wabar impact crater field
independent_site_set_v1.age: about 290 +/- 38 years before modern dating reference; roughly three centuries old
independent_site_set_v1.why_included: young desert-sand impact glass with well preserved shock and melt sequence

independent_site_set_v1.name: Nordlinger Ries
independent_site_set_v1.why_included: well dated source crater plus distal glass field

independent_site_set_v1.name: Bosumtwi impact crater
independent_site_set_v1.why_included: source crater and distal glass linkage by age, chemistry and isotopes

independent_site_set_v1.name: Darwin glass / Darwin Crater
independent_site_set_v1.why_included: large siliceous glass strewn field with defined candidate source crater

independent_site_set_v1.name: Aouelloul crater
independent_site_set_v1.why_included: small Saharan crater with glass and oblique-impact evidence

independent_site_set_v1.name: Tenoumer crater
independent_site_set_v1.age: published ages are uncertain; Meteoritical Bulletin lists 21.4 +/- 9.7 ka

independent_site_set_v1.name: Lonar crater
independent_site_set_v1.why_included: non-silica target control showing that melt signatures depend on target lithology

anthropogenic_positive_control.name: Trinity Site trinitite
anthropogenic_positive_control.purpose: known artificial heat source producing desert glass; must not score as celestial evidence

lightning_positive_control.purpose: known natural high-energy electrical fusion of sand/rock; must remain distinct from impact glass

giza_negative_control.purpose: a no-melt site cannot be promoted to a successful jet strike; failed-technology interpretation remains metaphor until material evidence appears

chronology_firewalls: Present-day Orion Belt geometry may not be back-projected tens of millions of years without stellar kinematics.
The Orion OB1b/Belt population is only a few to roughly ten million years old, so the present Belt cannot be the source of 28.5 Ma Libyan Desert Glass.
Deep-time impact sites cannot be linked to an Egyptian funerary tradition by name similarity or later artifact use alone.
Wabar is only about three centuries old and therefore cannot be the origin event of Old Kingdom Pyramid Text traditions.
Absence of vitrification at Giza is not evidence that an ancient device almost worked.

required_geometry_before_run.rule_1: Freeze the exact physical source model before examining site scores: EDEM point source, LOVE point source, Orion Belt great-circle, or a separately defined source.
required_geometry_before_run.rule_2: For terrestrial directional tests include Earth rotation, event epoch, axial precession/nutation model where applicable, and plate-motion uncertainty.
required_geometry_before_run.rule_3: For Myr-scale sites present J2000 RA/Dec is invalid as an event direction unless stellar/source phase-space evolution can be reconstructed.
required_geometry_before_run.rule_4: Each real site receives the same fit freedom as randomized terrestrial controls.
required_geometry_before_run.rule_5: No site may be added or removed after scoring without opening a new generation and preserving this frozen layer.

next_gate.name: GLOBAL_VITRIFICATION_SOURCE_MODEL_AND_NULL_GATE_V1
next_gate.first_action: Classify sites by age/reconstructability before any EDEM/LOVE/Orion sky fitting.
next_gate.promotion_rule: No Osiris-return, jet, burial or ancient-technology claim unless physical site evidence, chronology and preregistered geometry all independently pass.
